warnings: Infrastructure tests require InternalsVisibleTo for UCRDatabaseContext and SqlLearningComponentRepository (both internal). Implementation agent must add [assembly: InternalsVisibleTo] or make types accessible.
Test project .csproj files need ProjectReference entries to their respective production projects (Backend.Domain, Backend.Application, Backend.Infrastructure, Backend.Presentation) to compile.
Infrastructure.Tests.Unit.csproj needs a PackageReference to Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore to access DbSet<T> and DbContextOptions<T> for mocking.
Presentation.Tests.Unit.csproj needs a PackageReference to Microsoft.AspNetCore.App framework reference to access TypedResults, Ok<T>, BadRequest<T>, NotFound<T>, and IResult types.
notes: Generated 15 test methods across 4 DDD layers covering all 21 confirmed intents for story CPD-LC-001-001 (List learning components of a learning space). Domain tests use parameterized TestCaseSource for negative dimension/coordinate validation (6 cases in 1 method) and TestCase for valid orientations (4 cases in 1 method). Application tests combine null and empty string validation into a single parameterized method. Infrastructure tests use a MockDbSetHelper with async query provider support for EF Core ToListAsync mocking. Presentation tests cover Ok, BadRequest, and NotFound result types with mocked service.
